input: Find a notary for the power of attorney document

gold.taskTitle: Find a Notary for Power of Attorney Document
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to locate and arrange a notary to officially notarize a power of attorney document.

questions.title: What type of power of attorney is this?
questions.description: Understand whether it is general, durable, medical, financial, or limited power of attorney, as this affects notarization requirements.

questions.title: In which city and state must this be notarized?
questions.description: Identify the location where the notarization needs to take place, since notary rules and availability vary by state.

questions.title: By what date does this need to be notarized?
questions.description: Determine the deadline or urgency so the search and scheduling can be prioritized accordingly.

questions.title: How many people must sign before the notary?
questions.description: Find out the number of signers so the right notary appointment or mobile service can be arranged.

questions.title: Is the document already drafted and ready to sign?
questions.description: Confirm whether the POA document is fully prepared, or if drafting help is also needed before notarization.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person, mobile, or online notary?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred format for notarization to narrow down suitable notary services.

questions.title: What is your budget for the notary service?
questions.description: Understand any cost constraints, since fees vary widely between bank notaries, mobile notaries, and online services.
